prompt: Create a bright, dreamy anime-style full-body illustration of a young summer girl standing in a sunlit white garden pavilion. She has short black hair with white highlights, large clear blue eyes, fair skin, and a gentle shy morning expression. She wears a pale sky-blue off-shoulder sundress with thin straps, translucent puff sleeves, layered sheer ruffled hems, and light blue trim, plus white platform sandals. Add a cream woven straw sunhat decorated with a small pale-blue flower on the side; her right hand lightly holds the brim of the hat while her left hand delicately lifts the edge of the skirt. The pose is graceful and slightly tilted, one leg relaxed forward, creating a soft breezy summer feeling. Set the scene in an elegant open-air gazebo with tall white columns, ornate arched glass-and-metal roof details, white marble floor, distant greenery, blue sky, and fluffy clouds. Use strong morning backlight from behind her head, glowing sun rays, soft lens flares, overexposed highlights, pastel colors, airy transparency in the fabric, delicate line art, refined anime rendering, and a peaceful vacation-morning atmosphere. No text, no watermark, no extra characters.
